meta.purpose: Agent map for QA Est Structure formula — draft vs remaining vs original estimate, epic rollup, lane filters, exclusions.

qa_lanes.cr: QA Task + Test cases review (excluded from v1 rollup only)
qa_lanes.tc: QA Task Test cases development OR Test Execution *Test Case Development*

rollup_by_version.v1: in_qa_lane_agg = RA + TC + Validation (no CR hours in SUM#leaves)
rollup_by_version.v2: in_qa_lane_agg = all QA lanes including CR

epic_scope_layers.label: epic_in_scope branch: qa-no-task → blank; slot/incomplete guards unchanged
epic_scope_layers.pmoproc: scope_epics_in_subtree branch for non-scoped Epic rows; show_blank exclusions unchanged

layer_rollup_gate.description: Layer aggregation ignores scoped Epics that are not defined or incomplete.
qualified_epic_conditions: scoped status (Validation, Pending Fix, Under Implementation)
NOT p_incomplete (slot coverage + duplicate TC + missing estimate checks)

leaf: JQL/SJQL Fixed Cost Corner Trader M&S (PMOPROC)
blank_rows: summary Archive / Active Epics (ph4/ph5) / Active Epics (Other)
Fixed Cost Corner Trader M&S patterns

incomplete_triggers: NOT (slot_ra AND slot_cr AND slot_tc AND slot_val) in subtree
duplicate_tc: more than one TC-pattern issue in subtree
missing_est: open QA-lane leaf without draft or remaining estimate
aggregation: SUM#leaves#strict on ticket_est for leaves matching counts_in_sum (uses in_qa_lane_agg per version)
